description: Coco Watcherdog is MyRepublic's read-only analytics assistant for Pocket Rocket Adventures (PRA) and Space Station (SS).

interface.longDescription: Coco Watcherdog is MyRepublic's analytics assistant for authorized MyRepublic internal staff. Users can ask Coco questions about Pocket Rocket Adventures (PRA) and Space Station using natural language. Coco can retrieve read-only Google Analytics 4 data to answer questions about users, activity, usage trends, date ranges, and period comparisons. For example, users can ask how many people played PRA today, compare activity between two periods, or review Space Station usage trends. Access requires authentication and is restricted to authorized MyRepublic staff only. Coco does not modify Google Analytics data.
capabilities: Check active users and player counts
